item.title: Whiz 0.15.0
item.description:
• Mixed-language calls: each stretch is transcribed in the language actually spoken, so a call that switches between languages no longer comes out garbled.
  • Repeated lines repaired: a stretch where the transcript repeats one line over and over is re-transcribed, or reduced to one line with a warning.
  • Frames always come with the HTML transcript: turn frames on and you get the page to see them in.
  • Recording permission: Whiz no longer refuses to record after you allowed it, and no longer asks over and over.
  • How it ran: see how long each step of a transcription took.
